⚠️ Notification access is on, but notifications from DMs are blocked. Allow them in Settings › Apps › DMs › Notifications.
⚠️ Notification access is on, but Android hasn\'t started the relay. Tap Turn on, switch DMs OFF and back ON. On Xiaomi, also set Autostart ON for DMs (App info › Autostart).

A WebView can't receive Instagram push messages, but the Instagram app (or Chrome) can. With Notification access, DMs turns their DM notifications into DMs notifications that open here. It doesn't use any extra battery, and nothing leaves your phone.

Setup:
1. Get Instagram's notifications on this phone, either:
 • install the Instagram app, log in with the same account and leave only its Messages notifications on (you never need to open it), or
 • in Chrome, open instagram.com, log in and allow notifications.
2. Tap Turn on, then allow Notification access for DMs.
3. Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO: in Settings › Apps › Manage apps, set Autostart ON and Battery saver to No restrictions for both DMs and Instagram.

If Android says "Restricted setting": tap App info → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then try again. Android does this for apps installed outside the Play Store.

DMs is a locked-down browser for instagram.com/direct.

Known limitations:
• Notifications need the Instagram app or Chrome to receive them first (⋮ › Message notifications).
• View-once photos/videos aren't sent to Instagram's website, so they say "open in the app".
• Calling depends on what Instagram's mobile website offers.
• Instagram website changes can break the nav-hiding.

Long-press a photo or video to save it to Pictures/DMs.
